svg.title: World modeling in the brain
svg.desc: The atlas has three main chapters. The fundamentals cover neurons, synapses, glia, plasticity, neuromodulators and neural representation. Architecture and dynamics covers how the whole brain is wired and the limbic, memory, control and language systems built on that wiring. Learning covers the objectives that steer learning, how cortex, basal ganglia, cerebellum and hippocampus each learn, training data and skills from conception to age 25, and theories of cognitive development.
